about: Manual placement research for the REPORT.md §4 stores (batch a2). Coordinates derive only from the cited evidence. The only Google Maps short link involved was resolved through the HTTP redirect Location header (curl -sI, and -L -o /dev/null -w url_effective); no Google Maps page content was fetched. OSM data from Overpass (one query at a time, endpoint fallback as in tools/scan-osm.mjs; answers with osm_base 2026-10-01 except where noted), the OSM API (node history) and Nominatim (one request at a time, UA mapa-tiendas-seed/1.0). Plus Codes decoded with a local Open Location Code decoder. Official coordinates of other chains' stores on the same street (Mass locator) used as house-number references, as tools/merge.mjs does. Districts checked with tools/seed/pip.mjs.
